import datetime, time  # noqa
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"], DATABASES={})
import django
django.setup()

from django.db import migrations, models
from django.db.migrations.writer import MigrationWriter

class CustomFunc:
    pass

def dummy(a, b):  # will serialize as import of this module? use a real importable func
    pass

migration = type("Migration", (migrations.Migration,), {
    "operations": [
        migrations.AddField(
            "mymodel",
            "myfield",
            models.DateTimeField(default=datetime.datetime(2012, 1, 1, 1, 1, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)),
        ),
        # an operation from a non-django module -> "import <module>" line
        migrations.RunPython(dummy, migrations.RunPython.noop),
    ],
})
out = MigrationWriter(migration).as_string()
header = out.split("class Migration")[0]
print(header)
lines = [l for l in header.splitlines() if l.startswith(("import ", "from "))]
mods = [l.split()[1] for l in lines]
styles = [l.split()[0] for l in lines]
# group by module: within same module, all "import" lines must precede "from" lines
ok = True
seen_from = set()
for mod, st in zip(mods, styles):
    if st == "from":
        seen_from.add(mod)
    elif mod in seen_from:
        ok = False
print("style-ordering-correct:", ok)
assert ok
EOF
